purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a Sa'auei'a breeding-ground pulse allocation under trophic scarcity and class pressure.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary pulse work, a missing mineral contribution, plural testimony, allocation, and four success-or-cost aftermath families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the apron establishing frame, worker introduction, routine choice hub, routine fold, Varo's arrival, the shortfall reveal, testimony choice hub, allocation fold, final threshold, and each ending family. The extinguishing road and empty packet receive their own pivotal reveal frame.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt restates visible geometry, material, light, bodies, and object positions in plain language. Named visible characters also point to stable visual refs. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints and are excluded from prompt assembly.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: painterly speculative-ecology storybook frame, restrained gouache and ink texture, deep eclipse blue with dim red-orange return light, cold blue bioluminescence, amber fungal signals, mineral earth colors, precise alien anatomy, tactile living infrastructure, humane logistical comedy, cinematic interactive-fiction composition with clear playable staging.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every image prompt from global_style_cue, the selected scene base_image_prompt, visual_character_refs only for characters or groups listed in that scene, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Exclude refs for absent or off-frame characters and exclude visual_continuity_notes.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture uses one compact outdoor apron from several fixed camera slots. The embedded map fixes zones, routes, sightlines, and staging well enough for draft illustrated replay planning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, lower the embedded map into a plan view or simple 3D blockout and feed camera-specific renders to image generation as geometry input.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide elevated view of a crescent outdoor feeding apron made from dark root-bound stone. Four shallow ramps descend at the north edge into low nursery hollows beneath trees carrying cold blue light knots. A circular waist-low work rail surrounds a shallow pulse basin at center. Two rows of amber fungal beads enter from the west. A ribbed mineral heat braid and several ash-striped herd animals occupy the east. Thin silver-green producer mats cover shallow wet ground beyond the south edge. An enormous fixed black planet releases a dim red-orange sun from eclipse overhead. The resource circuit is readable as north nursery, west road, east heat, south wetland, and central basin.

visible_characters.default_stance: several adults folded broadside at the east heat braid with calves inside the herd

visual_continuity_notes: North always means nurseryward; south means wetlandward; west is the fungal-road entry; east is the glassback heat braid; the pulse basin stays central.
Umbros remains fixed in the sky direction across every frame; only the amount of sun uncovered changes.

The east heat braid is cold, western mineral beads retract into dark soil, the fourth northern ramp is unlit, south wetland pores are tightly closed, and the basin membrane glows red around one sealed half-filled graft bath.

review_notes: Narrative review accepted the ordinary-work opening, reader orientation, material choices, branch folds, state-gated outcomes, and warm logistical-comedy tone after the shortage reveal became its own Ink knot.

Lore review accepted the fixture after unsupported glassback leg-count language was removed and the pulse basin, heat braid, exact locality, and reproductive mechanics were bounded as story-local or unresolved.

Visual review accepted the thirteen-screen segmentation, standalone affirmative prompts, visible-character-only refs, branch/state modifiers, and embedded scene-set map for B-level draft replay planning.

Spatial review accepted the fixed north-west-east-south coordinate frame, Sa'auei'a reach, object custody, Varo arrival limit, herd grazing loop, Oru guardian step, and branch-persistent route changes.
A plan view or 3D blockout should replace the embedded textual map before high-consistency multi-angle website rendering; no images were generated in this pass.
